Cisco IOS-XE Quick Reference

This is a plain-text fixture used by the RAG extract tests. The contents
need to round-trip through extract_text() and produce at least 100
characters of clean text.

Common show commands:
  show running-config       - display active configuration
  show ip interface brief   - list interface state
  show ip bgp summary       - display BGP neighbor summary

Common configuration snippet:
  interface GigabitEthernet1
   ip address 10.0.0.1 255.255.255.0
   no shutdown
